يبتهجون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَهِجُونَ (yabtahijūna) /jab.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# يُبْتَهَجُونَ (yubtahajūna) /jub.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
